_about: What a suspect blurts out when their nerves reach the top (Engine.nerves, at 100). Every suspect who cracks, guilty or not, says the same kind of thing: they swear they did not do it (the culprit is lying) and, to get you off their back, say where the paper really left from. Keyed by the variant's 'where' option. So a crack gives one part of the answer and never shows who is guilty. No line names a suspect, a card or a time, and none says how it was done.

where.library_print_station: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it was printed, in the library. Go and ask who stood at that printer, not me."
where.professor_office: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it never left the faculty. It was taken from that office. Ask who had a reason to be there."
where.chiado_restaurant: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: nothing was printed. It left the building over dinner, at a restaurant in Chiado. Ask who sat at that table."
where.beach_cafe: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it changed hands at the beach café. Ask who was there that evening."
where.residence: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it went out from the residence. Ask who was in that building."
